summary: The final integration path removes routine Forge semantic subprocesses and makes environment entry bounded. A nine-iteration micro-verifier benchmark reports setup 7.133 s in a fresh temporary project, verifier p50 2.156 s and p95/p99 2.817 s, and state-inspect p50 2.797 ms with p95/p99 47.734 ms; the first state sample is the projection establishment. In one measured verifier, provider work was about 31 ms, action publication 282 ms, and receipt-plus-result batch publication 998 ms, so Forge/Store orchestration was about 1.315 s. A controlled environment enter took 6.54 s cold while starting both residents and 0.25 s warm; its capsule is bounded and performs no repository-family enumeration. The remaining pressure is durable Store publication and first-fill artifact admission.

workaround.description: Use continuous enter and resident Forge/Language Service state; Store artifact cache hits are retained rather than forcing a new identity shortcut.
